name: Jessica Anna Dahan
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in New York, New York
about: At the law office of Berkman Bottger Newman & Schein, LLP, in New York City, New York, Jessica Anna Dahan serves her clients in resolving their family law issues and always puts their needs first. Thorough and methodical in her approach, she helps her clients with:

With nearly a decade of experience practicing family law, Ms. Dahan understands the emotional and financial strain her clients face throughout their ordeal. She works hard to give them the peace of mind they deserve when making important decisions that affect their families. For her contribution to the legal field, she has been rated AV Preeminent* through Martindale-Hubbell, the organization’s highest peer-review rating and holds a “Very Good” rating on Avvo.

Ms. Dahan attended The George Washington University and graduated with her Bachelor of Arts degree in 2008. She then attended the Boston University School of Law and received her Juris Doctor in 2013. Admitted to practice in Massachusetts the same year, she received her license to practice in New York in 2014.

During her time in law school, Ms. Dahan was a Rule 3:03 Student Attorney at the Boston University Criminal Defenders Clinic and was part of the Boston University Jewish Law Students Association, the secretary for the Litigation Society and an article editor for the Public Interest Law Journal. Furthermore, she was a regional semi-finalist at the American Bar Association’s Client Counseling Competition and served as a law clerk at the Northern Virginia Capital Defender’s Office.

Ms. Dahan stays active in her legal community with active involvement with organizations such as the New York County Lawyers Association, the New York Women’s Bar Association and the New York State Bar Association.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer-review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Ratings™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
